rationale: Round 2 produced clearer quantification demands and an expert framing of the savings tests, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee/state actors still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management/shareholders/investors still insist they remain available unless a fully equivalent alternative is proven. The discussion is circling around the same red lines without a breakthrough, so a structured intervention or independent financial bridge review is more appropriate than another open-ended round.
